programs.title: In Good Shape
programs.desc: Mouth ulcers, gum disease, cavities — even the tongue — can provide warnings of diabetes, heart disease, and stroke. Learn what your mouth says about health.

programs.title: HER Women in Asia
programs.desc: Reduce, reuse and recycle — to live a waste free life is the goal of more and more  people around the world. But where to start? HER introduces women with creative and innovative ideas on how to consume less and recycle more. And sometimes it's also, about showing that even waste can be turned into something wonderful.

programs.title: Sports Life
programs.desc: After suffering two sudden cardiac deaths and a number of severe health complications, 32-year-old Tamara Schwab's life was saved by a heart transplant. She's now vowed not to waste a single minute of her second stint at life and is pushing herself to the limit to compete in the World Transplant Games. But can her body take it?
